    // Every structural check at once. All five fields are computed, so call
    // the individual range checks first on shells of unknown provenance.
    Validate(b: Brep3D, tolerance: Number): BrepValidation
        => (
            b.EdgesInRange,
            b.LoopUsesInRange,
            b.LoopsConnected,
            b.CurveEndpointsMatch(tolerance),
            b.IsWatertight);
